name: Mark Connolly
tagline: Top rated Personal Injury attorney in Chicago, Illinois
education: Northern Illinois University College of Law
about: Mark Connolly is a dedicated attorney at Connolly Injury Law, located in Chicago, Illinois. His practice is committed to serving clients in the areas of personal injury and workers' compensation, with a particular focus on motor vehicle accidents, construction mishaps, slip-and-fall incidents, workplace injuries, medical malpractice and product liability cases.

Mr. Connolly's journey into law was shaped by his strong work ethic, which he developed through diverse job experiences. Before entering the legal profession, he was an active member of Laborers’ Local #4, where he worked as a union laborer during his college years. This background provided him with a profound understanding of the value of hard work and perseverance. Upon completing law school, he served as an assistant counsel to the speaker of the Illinois House of Representatives. During this time, he played a role in the significant political event of assisting in the impeachment and removal of Governor Rod R. Blagojevich, an experience that enriched his legal acumen.

In 2009, Mr. Connolly discovered his passion for representing injured plaintiffs and petitioners, dedicating his career to advocating for those in need. His dedication led him to fulfill a lifelong ambition by establishing the Connolly Injury Law on May 1, 2021. This firm embodies his commitment to providing honest, innovative and straightforward legal services to clients during challenging times. Over the years, he has successfully resolved numerous cases through trial, settlement, mediation and arbitration, including multiple cases with settlements exceeding $1,000,000.

Educationally, Mr. Connolly is well-prepared, having graduated from the University of Notre Dame with a Bachelor of Arts in economics. He earned his law degree cum laude from Northern Illinois University College of Law. He is licensed to practice in Illinois, Wisconsin and Colorado, as well as in the United States District Court for the Northern District of Illinois. His geographical service areas primarily encompass these states, allowing him to extend his legal proficiency to a broad range of clients in need of support.
